top_signals.title: Investor Pushes Snap to Raise Capital for Eyeware Business Specs
top_signals.summary: Hedge fund Blue Duck Capital Partners wants Snap Inc. to raise capital by selling a stake in its nascent Specs unit, putting additional investor pressure on the social media app to deliver on its big investment in augmented reality glasses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Trade Deficit Widens to $105.6 Billion on Oil, Capital Goods
top_signals.summary: The US trade deficit widened sharply in August to the largest since early 2025, reflecting a surge in the value of imports of crude oil and capital goods.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Trump allows cheaper, dyed diesel on highways to blunt historic fuel cost spike ahead of midterms
top_signals.summary: The U.S. national average price of diesel topped $6 a gallon in September for the first time ever, as fuel supply disruptions pushed up transportation costs in the country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Russian lab worker's suspected plague death leaves some questions unanswered
top_signals.summary: Russian authorities say the situation is stable and there are no reports of secondary cases.
